question: Where can I find hotel inside 130 kilometers as I travel from the Grove, Washington, DC toward MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center, Rosedale, Maryland?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%The Grove%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Washington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%DC%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rosedale%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%Maryland%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 130000 ) );
